RepoCallAcknowledgementReason.name: Repo Call Acknowledgement Reason
RepoCallAcknowledgementReason.definition: Specifies additional information on the repurchase agreement call request acknowledgement.

CancellationReason.name: Cancellation Reason
CancellationReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the related instruction is cancelled, or the related cancellation request is executed.

PendingCancellationReason.name: Pending Cancellation Reason
PendingCancellationReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the cancellation request is pending.

GeneratedReason.name: Generated Reason
GeneratedReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the transaction was generated.

DeniedReason.name: Denied Reason
DeniedReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the request was denied.

AcknowledgedAcceptedReason.name: Acknowledged Accepted Reason
AcknowledgedAcceptedReason.definition: Specifies additional information about the processed instruction.

PendingReason.name: Pending Reason
PendingReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction has a pending status.

FailingReason.name: Failing Reason
FailingReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction has a failing settlement status.

PendingProcessingReason.name: Pending Processing Reason
PendingProcessingReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction has a pending processing status.

RejectionReason.name: Rejection Reason
RejectionReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction/request has a rejected status.

RepairReason.name: Repair Reason
RepairReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction is in repair.

PendingModificationReason.name: Pending Modification Reason
PendingModificationReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the modification request is pending.

UnmatchedReason.name: Unmatched Reason
UnmatchedReason.definition: Specifies the reason why the instruction has an unmatched status.

ReasonRule.definition: If the reason is requested, then it must be in line with the reasons available for the message type requested.
